summary: Codex successfully implemented the universal world examination information card system for WebTiles. Examination results dynamically render in a modern contextual information card near the top of the game screen across all supported dungeon entity types (monsters, items, altars, stairs, doors, traps, shops, portals, terrain, and clouds). The system seamlessly harmonizes with the existing top monster banner, eliminating double cards and visual occlusion. Strict zero-information-leak guarantees are enforced (LOS checks, unidentified item masking, hidden trap preservation, out-of-LOS monster suppression). Detailed examination popups (v) open with clean dynamic margin spacing below the card. All 22 Node unit tests, 24 .ai-team tests, and live browser gameplay verification passed completely.

findings.notes: Added structured `send_examine_card(coord_def gc, int request, bool detailed)` and JSON serialization in `tileweb.cc`. Hooks cleanly into `direction_chooser::describe_cell`, `describe_target`, and `finalize_moves`. Emits `examine_card` payload containing type, name, category, badge, tile index, wound bands, and key-value properties. Strictly checks `you.see_cell(gc)` and `cell.visible()`. Replaces unrevealed traps with apparent floor, omits out-of-LOS monsters, and strips curses/brands from unidentified items.

Creates lightweight, responsive `.er-examine-card` in `#monster_hud`. Seamlessly replaces `#top_target_card` when active, preventing duplicate monster cards. Renders sprites via `cell_renderer` / `util.init_canvas`. Debounces hover requests (70ms) with sequence token validation to prevent server flooding. Accurately updates on cursor movement (`x`, `v`, arrow keys, mouse move) and cleans up immediately on `Escape`, `game_cleanup`, or leaving dungeon view.

Dynamically computes `--er-examine-popup-top` from the bottom edge of `.er-examine-card` using ResizeObserver and CSS calc. Ensures modal inspection dialogues (`.describe-monster`, item inspection) open cleanly below the top card without overlap or visual collision.

Adheres to the dark fantasy palette: translucent obsidian backdrop (`rgba(16, 20, 26, 0.92)`), antique gold border (`#c49a45`), Cinzel serif typography for titles, uppercase category pills, and tone-specific badge chips (Unique/Runed gold, Dangerous/Hostile/Cursed crimson, Friendly/Open emerald, Neutral blue, Hazard orange). Fully responsive down to mobile viewports with prefers-reduced-motion support.

22/22 Node examination tests passed in `examination_card_test.js`, 9/9 floating events tests passed in `floating_events_test.js`, 24/24 `.ai-team` unittest tests passed, and incremental C++ compilation and link completed with exit code 0.

Verified live in WebTiles: 'x' look mode accurately displays stairs, floor, rock walls, unidentified blue potion, 2 stones (with quantity and throwable description), and frilled lizard (with health track, hostile badge, and range distance). 'v' opens detailed codex with perfect vertical spacing. 'Escape' returns smoothly to standard gameplay. Mouse hover inspection responds instantly.
